name.label: System Name
name.remark: Shown in the admin header and browser title

logo.label: System Logo
logo.remark: Recommended size 128×128; auto-generates favicon to uploads/favicon.ico when saved

favicon.label: Site Icon
favicon.remark: Browser tab icon; normalized to /storage/uploads/favicon.ico; auto-generated when Logo changes; defaults to /favicon.ico when empty

beian.label: ICP Filing Number
beian.remark: Website ICP filing number, e.g. Guangdong ICP 15000000-1

cdn_url.label: CDN URL
cdn_url.remark: Use when static assets are served from a third-party CDN

version.label: Version
version.remark: Increment when static assets change to bust cache

timezone.label: Timezone
timezone.remark: Default display timezone for the admin UI; DB stores UTC, lists format times in this zone; maintain options in dict site_timezone

forbidden_ip.label: Blocked IPs
forbidden_ip.remark: One IP per line; matching clients will be denied access

fixed_page.label: Default Home Page
fixed_page.remark: Menu route opened by default after login

enabled.label: Enable SMS
enabled.remark: When disabled, the system will not send SMS notifications

access_key.label: AccessKey ID
access_key.remark: AccessKey ID from your cloud provider console

secret_key.label: AccessKey Secret
secret_key.remark: AccessKey Secret from your cloud provider console

sign_name.label: SMS Signature
sign_name.remark: Approved signature name on the SMS platform

template_code.label: Default Template ID
template_code.remark: Default SMS template ID for verification codes and similar

app_id.label: App / Channel ID
app_id.remark: Tencent Cloud SdkAppId, or Huawei Cloud SMS sender channel ID

enabled.label: Enable Inbox
enabled.remark: When disabled, new inbox messages will not be created

retention_days.label: Message Retention Days
retention_days.remark: 0 means keep forever; expired messages will be purged

page_size.label: Inbox Page Size
page_size.remark: Default page size for the inbox list

category_notice.label: Notice
category_notice.remark: Whether notice messages appear in the inbox

category_approval.label: Approval
category_approval.remark: Whether approval messages appear in the inbox

category_task.label: Task
category_task.remark: Whether task messages appear in the inbox

category_crm.label: CRM
category_crm.remark: Whether CRM messages appear in the inbox

category_alert.label: Security
category_alert.remark: Whether security messages appear in the inbox

smtp_host.label: SMTP Host
smtp_host.remark: Incorrect settings may cause mail delivery timeouts

smtp_pass.label: SMTP Password
smtp_pass.remark: Mailbox password or SMTP authorization code

page_size.label: Default Page Size
page_size.remark: Default page size for admin lists

flow_page_size.label: Flow View Page Size
flow_page_size.remark: Default page size for attachment flow view

timeout.label: API Timeout
timeout.remark: HTTP request timeout for the admin app (seconds)

ttl.label: Login Idle Timeout
ttl.remark: Admin token idle timeout in minutes; renewed on API activity, re-login required after inactivity

captcha.label: Login Captcha
captcha.remark: Whether to enable captcha on the admin login page

maintenance.label: Maintenance Mode
maintenance.remark: When enabled, regular admins cannot access the admin app

driver.label: Default Storage Driver
driver.remark: Default disk for uploads; public storage is available at /storage

allowed_ext.label: Allowed Extensions
allowed_ext.remark: JSON array of allowed file extensions

public_url.label: Public Base URL
public_url.remark: For cloud drivers; leave blank for public storage to use APP_URL/storage

access_key.label: OSS AccessKey ID
access_key.remark: Required when using Alibaba Cloud OSS

secret_key.remark: Required when using Alibaba Cloud OSS

endpoint.label: OSS Endpoint
endpoint.remark: e.g. oss-cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com; auto-generated from region if empty

secret_id.label: COS SecretId
secret_id.remark: Required when using Tencent Cloud COS

secret_key.label: COS SecretKey
secret_key.remark: Required when using Tencent Cloud COS

endpoint.label: COS Endpoint
endpoint.remark: Auto-generated from region if empty, e.g. cos.ap-guangzhou.myqcloud.com

access_key.remark: Required for AWS S3 or S3-compatible storage

secret_key.label: S3 Secret Key
secret_key.remark: Required for AWS S3 or S3-compatible storage

region.remark: AWS region identifier, e.g. us-east-1, ap-southeast-1
